name: index-engine
description: EFNAI V9.1.0.1 nomenclature engine, self-contained SPA, and terminal command engine. Tailwind is inlined at maintenance time; the shipped SPA runs without a build step.

scripts.lint: npm run check:version && npm run check:workflows && npm run lint:html && npm run macos:check && npm test
scripts.macos:check: npm run macos:sync && npm run macos:verify
scripts.macos:build: npm run macos:sync && xcodebuild -project mobile/macos/IndexEngine.xcodeproj -scheme IndexEngine -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath mobile/macos/DerivedData build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.macos:archive:unsigned: npm run macos:sync && xcodebuild -project mobile/macos/IndexEngine.xcodeproj -scheme IndexEngine -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath mobile/macos/DerivedData -archivePath mobile/macos/build/Index-Engine.xcarchive CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO archive
